description: Avsluta avvikelsen: Uppnå låg latens och Airtime Fairness i WiFi is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Karlstads universitet. This is the dataset and companion website to the paper Ending the Anomaly: Achieving Low Latency and Airtime Fairness in WiFi which was published at USENIX ATC 17. Also published at. Coverage: Karlstads universitet. The portal shows the English title as "Ending the Anomaly: Achieving Low Latency and Airtime Fairness in WiFi" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Karlstads universitet. The listing shows 2020-01-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
